summary: Synthesised drum kit in the TR-909 and TR-808 manner: kick, snare, clap, rim, closed and open hats (the closed one chokes the open one), low, mid and high toms, cowbell, crash and ride, each with its tune, decay, tone or snap (and the kick its sweep, click and drive), level and pan. Plays the General MIDI drum keys from C2 (kick C2, snare D2, closed hat F#2, open hat A#2), as Neo Sampler's Kit mode does, or per-track hit columns (BD, SD, … with a velocity) and an Accent column, as Buzz drum machines do. Velocity sets the level and opens the tone. Use it for drum parts.

parameters.name: Volume
parameters.description: Output level

parameters.name: Accent gain
parameters.description: How much louder an accented hit plays (a hit on a row with Accent): a TR-909's accent

parameters.name: Vel → level
parameters.description: How much velocity sets a hit's level: the gain is velocity^(2 × this) (100 %: velocity 64 is −12 dB; 0 %: every hit at full level)

parameters.name: Vel → tone
parameters.description: How much velocity (and accent) opens a hit: the kick's click and sweep, the snare's snap and tone, the toms' attack, the hats' and cymbals' tone; a hit at velocity 100 sounds as its parameters say

parameters.name: Kick tune
parameters.description: The body's pitch once its sweep has settled

parameters.name: Kick sweep
parameters.description: How far above its tune the body starts, falling to it

parameters.name: Kick sweep time
parameters.description: The sweep's time constant: the pitch is 63 % of the way down after this

parameters.name: Kick decay
parameters.description: Time for the body to fall 60 dB

parameters.name: Kick click
parameters.description: Level of the attack's click (a short burst of high-passed noise)

parameters.name: Kick punch
parameters.description: How much louder the body starts (up to +12 dB at 100 %), falling back with the sweep: a TR-909's attack

parameters.name: Kick drive
parameters.description: Saturation of the body, its level kept

parameters.name: Kick level
parameters.description: Level of the kick

parameters.name: Kick pan
parameters.description: Where the kick sits, from −100 % (left) to +100 % (right)

parameters.name: Snare tune
parameters.description: The body's lower tone, once its short fall has settled (the upper sits an octave above)

parameters.name: Snare tone
parameters.description: Centre of the snappy noise's band (from about half of it to 1.3 times it): brighter up

parameters.name: Snare snap
parameters.description: The snappy noise against the body (0 %: the body alone)

parameters.name: Snare decay
parameters.description: Time for the snappy noise to fall 60 dB (the body takes about half)

parameters.name: Snare level
parameters.description: Level of the snare

parameters.name: Snare pan
parameters.description: Where the snare sits, from −100 % (left) to +100 % (right)

parameters.name: Clap tune
parameters.description: Centre of the clap's band-pass

parameters.name: Clap spread
parameters.description: Time between the clap's three bursts

parameters.name: Clap decay
parameters.description: Time for its tail to fall 60 dB

parameters.name: Clap level
parameters.description: Level of the clap

parameters.name: Clap pan
parameters.description: Where the clap sits, from −100 % (left) to +100 % (right)

parameters.name: Rim tune
parameters.description: Pitch of the rim shot's highest ping (the others sit at half and 0.23 of it)

parameters.name: Rim decay
parameters.description: Time for its pings to fall 60 dB

parameters.name: Rim level
parameters.description: Level of the rim shot

parameters.name: Rim pan
parameters.description: Where the rim shot sits, from −100 % (left) to +100 % (right)

parameters.name: Closed hat tune
parameters.description: Pitch of the six metallic oscillators, in semitones from the TR-808's

parameters.name: Closed hat tone
parameters.description: Centre of the band the hats ring in (more above it, a little across the mids): brighter up

parameters.name: Closed hat decay
parameters.description: Time to fall 60 dB

parameters.name: Closed hat level
parameters.description: Level of the closed hat

parameters.name: Closed hat pan
parameters.description: Where the closed hat sits, from −100 % (left) to +100 % (right)

parameters.name: Open hat tune
parameters.description: Pitch of the six metallic oscillators, in semitones from the TR-808's

parameters.name: Open hat tone
parameters.description: Centre of the band the hats ring in (more above it, a little across the mids): brighter up

parameters.name: Open hat decay
parameters.description: Time to fall 60 dB (a closed hat cuts it in 5 ms)

parameters.name: Open hat level
parameters.description: Level of the open hat

parameters.name: Open hat pan
parameters.description: Where the open hat sits, from −100 % (left) to +100 % (right)

parameters.name: Low tom tune
parameters.description: The tom's pitch once its sweep has settled (it starts 1.2 octaves above, falls an octave in about 25 ms, then the rest over about a second)

parameters.name: Low tom decay
parameters.description: Time to fall 60 dB

parameters.name: Low tom tone

parameters.description: Level of the low tom

parameters.name: Low tom pan
parameters.description: Where the low tom sits, from −100 % (left) to +100 % (right)
